tools.name: get_item
tools.description:
Fetch a single item by its ID (https://docs.example.com/items/get). Returns the full record.

Example: get_item({"workspaceId": "ws_1", "id": "42"}) returns the item.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that owns the item being used.

note.description: Optional note recorded in the audit log

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: List items in a workspace. Pass cursor to page, e.g. the nextCursor of the previous page.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that owns the item being used.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. For example: 50

filter.description: Reserved for future filters and must stay empty

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Update fields of an existing item.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that owns the item being used.

id.description: Identifier of the item to update

note.description: Optional note recorded in the audit log

workspaceId.description: Workspace that owns the item being used.

id.description: Identifier of the item to delete

note.description: Optional note recorded in the audit log

tools.name: archive_item
tools.description: Move an item to the archive. Archived items are hidden from list_items.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that owns the item being used.

id.description: Identifier of the item to archive

note.description: Reason for archiving, shown to reviewers
